tasks.title: Conversation #70
tasks.transcript:
Man: Didn't you tell me that you got your brushes at the arts supplies store for a big discount?
Woman: That's right. I went this morning and got a bunch 50% off.
Man: When I was just there, everything was regular price.
Woman: Were you looking at the clearance rack at the back of the store?
Man: Oh, that explains it.

questions.stem: What had the woman previously told the man?

options.A: That she had received a good deal on a purchase
options.B: That she was not happy with her new paint brushes
options.C: That a popular store was going out of business
options.D: That the art supply store was not open on Mondays

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：女士之前告诉过男士什么？ 定位原文：Man: Didn't you tell me that you got your brushes at the arts supplies store for a big discount? Woman: That's right. I went this morning and got a bunch 50% off. 选项分析： A. 她在一笔购买中得到了很好的折扣。男士明确复述了女士之前告诉他的信息：以很大的折扣买了刷子，女士也确认了，因此 A 选项正确。 B. 她对她的新画笔不满意。对话中没有提及她对画笔是否满意，因此 B 选项错误。 C. 一家受欢迎的商店要倒闭。对话中没有提到任何商店倒闭的信息，因此 C 选项错误。 D. 美术用品店周一不开门。对话中没有提到营业时间，因此 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the man imply when he says, "Oh, that explains it"?

options.A: The woman purchased products of inferior quality.
options.B: He was looking in the wrong section of the store.
options.C: He visited the store after the sale ended.
options.D: The items he wanted had already sold out.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男士说“哦，那就能解释通了”暗示了什么？ 定位原文：Man: When I was just there, everything was regular price. Woman: Were you looking at the clearance rack at the back of the store? Man: Oh, that explains it. 选项分析： A. 女士购买了劣质产品。男士并没有暗示产品质量问题，因此 A 选项错误。 B. 他看错了商店的区域。女士问他是否看了商店后面的清仓货架，男士意识到自己可能只看了正价商品区，因此他的回答暗示他找错了地方，因此 B 选项正确。 C. 他在促销结束后才去商店。女士当天早上刚以五折买到了刷子，男士随后去了，说明促销仍在进行，只是他没看对地方，因此 C 选项错误。 D. 他想要的商品已经卖光了。对话中没有提到商品售罄，因此 D 选项错误。
